title: Function to analyze autocorrelation estimates with bootstrapping — analyze.autocorr
code: set.seed(42) make_cell <- function(cell_id, hemi, n_trials = 20, trial_dur = 100, n_spikes = 10) {   times <- unlist(lapply(     seq_len(n_trials), function(tr) sort(sample(seq_len(trial_dur), n_spikes))   ))   data.frame(     cell = cell_id, time_in_ms = times,     trial = rep(seq_len(n_trials), each = n_spikes), hemi = hemi   ) } raster_df <- rbind(make_cell(1, "left"), make_cell(2, "right")) neurons <- load.rasters.as.neurons(raster_df, bin_size = 10)  ests <- estimate.autocorr.params(   neuron_list = neurons, n_trials_per_sim = 10, n_sims_per_neurons = 2, seed = 1 ) result <- analyze.autocorr(ests, covariate = "hemi", n_bs = 50) result #> <neuronsDG_analysis> #>   bootstrap resamples: 50  #>   covariate groups:    left, right  #>     left                 mean tau = 1.16 #>     right                mean tau = 1.16 plot(result)

title: Function to estimate autocorrelation parameters using dichotomized Gaussian simulations — estimate.autocorr.params
text: neuron_list R list neuron objects. n_trials_per_sim Number trials simulate simulation (default: 300). n_sims_per_neurons Number simulations run neuron (default: 100). bin_count_action Method counting spikes bin computing autocorrelation; one "boolean", "mean", "sum" (default: "sum"). max_lag Maximum lag (raw, unbinned units neuron's trial data) compute autocorrelation original dichotomized-Gaussian-simulated spike raster; 0, uses shortest raw trial length across neuron_list (default: 0). A0 Initial guess amplitude parameter exponential decay function (default: 0.001). tau0 Initial guess time constant parameter exponential decay function (default: 1.0). ctol Convergence tolerance fitting exponential decay function (default: 1e-8). max_evals Maximum number evaluations fitting exponential decay function (default: 500). use_raw Logical indicating whether use raw autocorrelation (true) standard centered normalized correlation (false) (default: TRUE). seed Integer seed dichotomized-Gaussian simulation draws (default: 12345). draws made self-contained C++ random number generator, R's , set.seed() effect – reproducibility controlled entirely argument. neuron neuron_list gets seed, offset one neurons share draw sequence.

title: Function to estimate autocorrelation parameters using dichotomized Gaussian simulations — estimate.autocorr.params
text: neuronsDG_estimates object: list containing data frame autocorrelation parameter estimates (one row per simulation), data frame neuron identifiers (one row per neuron), number simulations run per neuron. See print.neuronsDG_estimates.

title: Function to estimate autocorrelation parameters using dichotomized Gaussian simulations — estimate.autocorr.params
code: # A well-conditioned example needs more trials/spikes than process.autocorr()'s # minimal examples, so the dichotomized-Gaussian fit underneath isn't degenerate. set.seed(42) make_cell <- function(cell_id, hemi, n_trials = 20, trial_dur = 100, n_spikes = 10) {   times <- unlist(lapply(     seq_len(n_trials), function(tr) sort(sample(seq_len(trial_dur), n_spikes))   ))   data.frame(     cell = cell_id, time_in_ms = times,     trial = rep(seq_len(n_trials), each = n_spikes), hemi = hemi   ) } raster_df <- rbind(make_cell(1, "left"), make_cell(2, "right")) neurons <- load.rasters.as.neurons(raster_df, bin_size = 10)  ests <- estimate.autocorr.params(   neuron_list = neurons, n_trials_per_sim = 10, n_sims_per_neurons = 2, seed = 1 ) ests #> <neuronsDG_estimates> #>   neurons:           2  #>   sims per neuron:   2  #>   total simulations: 4  #>   mean tau:          1.16  #>   mean A:            0.3406

text: id_num Numeric identifier neuron (default: 0). recording_name Recording () neuron based (default: "not_provided"). type Modeled electrophysiology neuron, e.g. "generic", "blackbox" "LIF", "McCullochPitts", "excitatory", "inhibitory", etc. (default: "generic"). genotype Genotype animal, e.g. "WT", "KO", "MECP2", "transgenic", etc. (default: "not_provided"). sex Sex animal (default: "not_provided"). hemi Hemisphere neuron neuron located, e.g. "left", "right" (default: "not_provided"). region Brain region neuron located, e.g. "V1", "M1", "CA1", "PFC", etc. (default: "not_provided"). age Age animal, e.g. "P0", "P7", "P14", "adult", etc. (default: "not_provided"). sim Logical indicating neuron simulated (TRUE) recorded (FALSE) (default: FALSE). unit_time Unit time spike raster recording data, e.g. "ms", "s", etc. (default: "ms"). unit_sample_rate Unit sample rate spike raster recording data, e.g. "Hz", "kHz", etc. (default: "Hz"). unit_data Unit data spike raster recording data, e.g. "mV", "spike", etc. (default: "mV"). t_per_bin Time (units) per bin, e.g., 1 ms per bin (default: 10.0). sample_rate Sample rate (units), e.g., 1e4 Hz (default: 1e4).

title: Function to process autocorrelation of neuron list — process.autocorr
text: neuron_list R list neuron objects. bin_count_action Method counting spikes bin computing autocorrelation; one "boolean", "mean", "sum" (default: "sum"). max_lag Maximum lag (units trial data) compute autocorrelation; 0, uses number time bins neuron's trial data (default: 0). A0 Initial guess amplitude parameter exponential decay function (default: 0.001). tau0 Initial guess time constant parameter exponential decay function (default: 1.0). ctol Convergence tolerance fitting exponential decay function (default: 1e-8). max_evals Maximum number evaluations fitting exponential decay function (default: 500). check_autofiring_ratio Logical indicating whether check assumption autocorrelation values mean firing rate test.sigma.assumption function (default: FALSE). print_plots Logical indicating whether print autocorrelation plots neuron (default: FALSE). plot_time_cutoff Maximum lag (bins) display x-axis plots (default: Inf). use_raw Logical indicating whether use raw autocorrelation (true) standard centered normalized correlation (false) (default: TRUE).
